findings.detail: Equity subtotal rows repeat 291, 3,250, and 152 of fair value; those 3,693 thousand are subtotals, not additional positions.
Unfunded Portfolio Company Commitments have total fair value of (377) thousand and should not be included in funded investment fair-value conservation.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the filing schedule total is 355,200 thousand: table 16 row 17 reports total non-controlled-non-affiliated Portfolio Company investments of 355,200, and summary tables also report total fair value of 355,200. The extracted position sum is 358,516 thousand, a 3,316 thousand overshoot against the companyfacts_fv anchor. The row-disposition structure localizes the net residual: table 16 contains blank subtotal rows for preferred stock, common stock, and L.P. interest that repeat 291 + 3,250 + 152 = 3,693 thousand of fair value, while the commitment table total shows (377) thousand of unfunded commitments. Including both explains 3,693 - 377 = 3,316 thousand, matching the overshoot.
